operations.description:
This webservice is providing you the ability to retrieve a list of airports matching your search criterias.
The 3 mains search criterias are
- by country code, this will list all airports for a given country.
- by latitude/longitude with a radius in km. You can actually combine those 2 criterias, and search for example the closest airport in the USA of Vancoucer, Canada.
- The last way to use the API is by searching directly with a IATA CODE in the location parameter, this will only return one result in the array of data results
operations.summary: Search airports by country / Search nearby airports / Search an airport
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] airport [PATH] airports [PARAMS] airports countrycode language location radius top [SCHEMA] airports data response search

operations.description:
Search cities according to given criterias. Either lat/long + radius or country code. A limit can be given but cannot exceed 50 results.
A significant city will be defined according to the pourcent of population within a country.
operations.summary: Search all cities from lat/long or countrycode
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] cities [PATH] cities findcitiesfromlatlong [PARAMS] countrycode language limit location offset radius sort [SCHEMA] cities data response

operations.description: Search cities from a string parameters.
operations.summary: Retrieve cities informations from a string / build an autocomplete
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] autocomplete [PATH] cities findcitiesfromtext [PARAMS] countrycode language q sort [SCHEMA] cities data response

operations.description:
Search cities according to given criterias. Either lat/long + radius or country code. A limit can be given but cannot exceed 50 results.

operations.summary: Search significant cities from lat/long or countrycode
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] significant cities [PATH] cities significant [PARAMS] countrycode language limit location offset pourcent radius sort [SCHEMA] cities data response

operations.description: This webservice is providing you the ability to retrieve all informations about continents
operations.summary: Search all continents or one specific continent
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] continents [PATH] continents [PARAMS] continentcode language [SCHEMA] continent continents data response

operations.description:
This webservice is providing you the ability to retrieve a list of countries matching your search criterias.
The 2 mains ways to search use this API are
- by countrycode, it will only returns you one country
- without the countrycode parameter which will return the full list of countries
operations.summary: Search all countries or one specific country
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] countries [PATH] countries [PARAMS] countrycode language [SCHEMA] countries data response

operations.description: This webservice is providing you the ability to calculate the distance between 2 lat/long points, it returns you the value in km or miles
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] distance [PATH] distance [PARAMS] a b location unit [SCHEMA] distance response

operations.description:
This webservice is providing you the ability to retrieve the elevation in meters or feet of ONE or MULTIPLE given latitude/longitude point(s).
If you use MULTIPLE lat/long point, the maximum number of point you can send in one request is 256. Be aware that if MULTIPLE mode, the results are de-deplicated if you are sending the same latitude/longitude point multiple times.
If your workload is a batch of millions of lat/long point, You will also get better throughput if you send around 100 lat/long points in one request than the maximum. This maximum is mostly allowed for people trying to graph altitudes.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] elevation [PATH] elevation [PARAMS] locations unit [SCHEMA] data elevation response

operations.description: Returns a ping. In case you need a health check in your system. Cannot be called /ping as AWS is using this route for their health check. This webservice doesn't have CORS enable, as it's supposed to be call server to server and not from a webpage ( it won't work over the tester)

This webservice is providing you the ability to retrieve the time of each phases of the sunlight cycle. Sunset, sunrise, sunriseEnd, golden hour, solarNoon, dawn, dusk and more for a given location and date. If the date if not provided, the response provided return informations for today at UTC time.
operations.summary: Search position of sun from lat/long and date
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] sun [PATH] sun positions [PARAMS] date location [SCHEMA] data position response sun

operations.description: This webservice is providing you the ability to retrieve the tz database time zones ( https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones )  from a given location ( )latitude and longitude or IATA code ). It also returns you the current time at the provided location.
operations.summary: Search timezone and time informations from lat/long
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] timezone [PATH] timezone [PARAMS] location [SCHEMA] response timezone
